criticalFindings: BIRD-REF-001 is useful for coarse bilateral wing phase, leg/toe motion and head-tail coupling, not surface truth.
BIRD-REF-002 provides dense wing, tail, beak, eye and toe attachment controls, but 117 artist controls are not literal anatomical bones and the source license is non-commercial.
BIRD-REF-003 depicts a pigeon but uses a Chicken_* skeleton and has no explicit wing joints; it fails the Columbidae flight-kernel gate.
BIRD-REF-004 has a coarse Larid wing chain but no leg joints in the skin, so it cannot support ground or water contact production.
BIRD-REF-005 has mostly generic Bone.* names; manual transform and skin-weight mapping is required before semantic promotion.
BIRD-REF-006 provides long-neck and long-leg Ardeid candidates but lacks foot/toe and distal wrist-manus/feather semantics.
ANIMAL-BAT-REF-001 is a mammal membrane-wing counterexample and is excluded from the Original Bird shared kernel.
R0.03 produces the first visible massing, but overlapping body masses must not be confused with a continuous anatomical surface.
